description: This file defines an Android activity named 'SquashAndStretch' that demonstrates basic shape deformation during animation. It handles user interaction via a button click to animate a view with scaling and translation effects, creating a squash-and-stretch animation that simulates life-like bouncing behavior.

classes.name: SquashAndStretch
classes.description: An Android Activity that demonstrates squash-and-stretch animation effects on a button view, combining translation and scale transformations to simulate bouncing behavior.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and references the container view.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for controlling animation speed.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections to modify the animation scale factor.

methods.name: onButtonClick
methods.description: Performs a sequence of animated transformations on the clicked view, creating a squash-and-stretch bounce effect.
